summary: The implementation fully satisfies the original request, the Codex plan, and all 10 acceptance criteria. I independently verified the two claims not evidenced in the provided output: index.html exists with a proper responsive viewport meta tag, and `npm run build` exits 0 (produces dist/index.html, CSS, and JS bundles). The 36 automated tests pass, covering add/trim/clear, Enter submission, empty/whitespace rejection, independent toggle and delete, duplicate-text tasks with independent IDs, final-task deletion persisting an empty array, hydration from valid stored data, and graceful handling of corrupted/malformed storage, quota/security failures, and invalid or duplicate-id records. Logic is correct: functional immutable state updates key tasks by unique id, lazy useState initialization loads persisted tasks before the save effect runs (no initial-empty-state overwrite), and React rendering safely escapes HTML-like text. Storage failures are caught and never propagate as uncaught errors. Accessibility (visible label, keyboard-operable checkbox/buttons, descriptive aria-labels, focus-visible rings) and responsive CSS (max-width container, flex controls, stacking at 380px, overflow-wrap for long text) meet the criteria. No bugs, missing requirements, or unhandled edge cases were found.
